title.value: Beyond variance reduction: Understanding the true impact of baselines on policy optimization
title.justification: The title is directly mentioned at the top of the paper, which is the standard location for a paper's title.
title.quote:
Beyond variance reduction: Understanding
the true impact of baselines on policy optimization

analysis.description: The paper explores the role of baselines in policy gradient methods and their impact on optimization beyond just variance reduction. It demonstrates that different baselines can lead to qualitatively different learning outcomes and convergence behaviors, particularly in reinforcement learning and multi-arm bandit problems.

type.justification: Although the paper includes empirical evaluations, its main focus is on providing theoretical insights and proofs regarding the impact of baselines on policy optimization.
